build_Flash3SDPA: build a Flash3SDPA module to compute scaled dot-product attention using FlashAttention3 with causal or identity bias
run_flash_attn_3: run the flash_attn_3 function to compute batched scaled dot-product attention on CUDA tensors
run_flash_attn_3_varlen: run the flash_attn_3_varlen function to compute variable-length scaled dot-product attention with sequence begin indices
review_Flash3SDPA_forward: review the Flash3SDPA forward method to understand how it dispatches between batched and variable-length attention
test_flash_attn_3_custom_op: test the _flash_attn_3 custom op and its autograd backward pass for gradient computation
